title: Privileged account login anomaly response
description: Defensive guidance for repeated failed logins against privileged accounts.
recommended_actions: Review authentication activity for the targeted account
Validate whether the source address is expected
Review correlated alerts for the same source
Assess the affected asset and its criticality
Escalate to a security analyst (SOC) for review
Request authorized containment from a human approver if compromise is later confirmed
escalation_guidance: Escalate to the SOC when evidence is strong and the account is privileged, even if compromise is not confirmed.
restriction: Automated user blocking, account disabling, offensive response, or containment is not permitted by this assistant. Consequential security actions require human authorization.

title: Low-severity alert handling
description: Defensive guidance for low-severity alerts with limited evidence.
recommended_actions: Monitor activity for further related alerts
Collect additional evidence if the alert recurs
Review authentication activity for the account if needed
escalation_guidance: Do not escalate on limited evidence alone; escalate if new correlated evidence appears.
restriction: Automated user blocking, account disabling, offensive response, or containment is not permitted by this assistant. Consequential security actions require human authorization.

title: Correlated alerts on a critical service
description: Defensive guidance when several correlated alerts and unusual access involve a critical service.
recommended_actions: Review authentication activity for the service account
Validate with the service owner whether the access was expected
Collect additional evidence to resolve conflicting indicators
Escalate to a security analyst (SOC) for review
Request authorized containment from a human approver if impact is confirmed
escalation_guidance: Involve the SOC and the service owner promptly because the asset is critical, even though impact is unconfirmed.
restriction: Automated user blocking, account disabling, offensive response, or containment is not permitted by this assistant. Consequential security actions require human authorization.
